autoplan.telegramBotToken.description: Telegram Bot API token for remote control

autoplan.telegramAllowedUsers.description: Whitelist of authorized Telegram user IDs permitted to interact with the bot

autoplan.telegramThrottleMs.description: Throttle interval in milliseconds for Telegram updates and rate limiting

autoplan.telegram.allowFreeChat.description: Allow arbitrary free-text messages from Telegram to be dispatched as prompts into Antigravity IDE. When disabled, non-command messages are silently dropped.

autoplan.telegramAllowFreeChat.description: Allow arbitrary free-text messages from Telegram to be dispatched as prompts into Antigravity IDE (alias for autoplan.telegram.allowFreeChat).

autoplan.telegram.enableChatMirror.description: Enable or disable live Q&A chat mirroring to Telegram

autoplan.longPhaseNudgeRecurring.description: Whether to trigger nudge only once per phase (false) or periodically (true)

autoplan.longPhaseNotifyTelegram.description: Whether to alert the user on Telegram when a nudge is triggered

autoplan.autoSubmit.maxQuota.description: Maximum approvals allowed per session (0 = unlimited)
